text.description_html:
LCN 4642-3971 Closer Body Only For Electric Door Opener 4642

The LCN 4642-3971-AL Body Only is for with the LCN 4642 Electric Door Opener and Door Closer. It provides easy access for people with disabilities, or the elderly. Designed primarily for manual opening applications that occasionally require automatic opening.

Specifications and Features: of LCN 4642 Electric Door Closer / Opener

  • Maximum Door Weight: 250 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 36" - 54" Interior / 36" - 42" Exterior
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Spring Size: Adjustable 3-5
  • Standard with Cover
  • Utilizes a 10,000,000 Cycle Heavy Duty Door Close

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
